faqs.answer: "Journeys end in lovers meeting" from Shakespeare's Twelfth Night (printed 1623) is 30 characters and public domain. For an original, try "You watch the scary part with your eyes open. faqs.question: Which classic poem works as a Halloween quote for her?
faqs.answer: Lord Byron's "She Walks in Beauty" (1815) opens "She walks in Beauty, like the night", which suits a girlfriend who loves dark costumes. Emily Dickinson's "Ghosts" (1891), beginning "One need not be a chamber to be haunted", suits a more thoughtful one.

faqs.question: Is "I will not let you go into the unknown alone" from Dracula?
faqs.answer: No. The line does not appear anywhere in the full text of Bram Stoker's 1897 novel on Project Gutenberg, even though quote pages credit it to Dracula. Use a line you can find in the text, with a chapter you can name.

faqs.question: Are these old quotes safe to copy into a card or post?
faqs.answer: Yes, for the US. Works published in 1930 or earlier are in the US public domain as of 1 January 2026, per Cornell University Library's copyright chart, and every classic here is from 1609 to 1891. Other countries use different rules, so check locally before printing anything for sale.

faqs.question: What Halloween quote should I send if we just started dating?
faqs.answer: Pick something light that does not promise forever, such as "Too early to say forever, so: same time next October?" A 2025 study of 808 young adults found men fell in love about a month earlier than women, so she may be at a different point than you.

faqs.question: What do I write for a girlfriend I've been with for years?
faqs.answer: Be specific and a little soppy: "You've seen me in every terrible costume and stayed anyway" works, or Shakespeare's Sonnet 116 (1609) read aloud. Swap any general word for the real number of Halloweens you have shared.

faqs.question: My girlfriend hates scary things. What Halloween quote fits her?
faqs.answer: Promise comfort instead of fright: "No jump scares tonight, only warm socks and a happy ending." Avoid horror references entirely, and if she dislikes Halloween itself, send a plain love note instead.

faqs.question: When is Halloween in 2026 and 2027?
faqs.answer: Halloween is always 31 October. It falls on a Saturday in 2026 and a Sunday in 2027, so a long-distance video call on the night is easier than usual in both years.

faqs.question: Can I put a Halloween quote inside a SubhSandesh Halloween page?
faqs.answer: Yes. The regular Halloween card lets you edit its closing question up to 60 characters, and the premium page holds a letter up to 3,000 characters plus a 60-second voice note. A short classic line fits the question field.

faqs.question: Should I post a Halloween quote about my girlfriend publicly?
faqs.answer: Only if it is something she would post herself. Lines about her body, her fears or private jokes belong in a message, and 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect their pages for exactly that kind of privacy.

# Halloween Quotes for Girlfriend, Matched to Her and Your Stage

The best Halloween quotes for your girlfriend fit who she is and how long you have been together. Below are 6 public-domain lines, each checked word for word against a primary text and dated, plus 36 original lines sorted by her personality and your relationship stage. Keep them short: 48.3% of shared SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone (27,725 of 57,456 views).

Keep some private, too: 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect a page before sharing it. Below are the classics, the originals, where each works and when a quote is the wrong move.

## What makes a Halloween quote right for your girlfriend?

A Halloween quote for a girlfriend is a short line, borrowed or original, that mixes the season's ghosts with something true about her. It works when she can tell it was picked for her.

Stage matters as much as taste. In a [2025 study of 808 people aged 18 to 25 who were in love](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC11849325), men reported falling in love about one month earlier than women, though most sex differences shrank once other factors were controlled. A "forever" line in week three can land as pressure, so new and long couples get separate lines below.

## 6 public-domain Halloween quotes for her, checked at the source (1609–1891)

Every line here was published in 1930 or earlier, which puts it in the US public domain under [Cornell University Library's copyright-term chart, updated 1 January 2026](https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain). Each was found in a full Project Gutenberg text, and each entry gives the source, who it suits and one use.

### 1. Lord Byron, "She Walks in Beauty" (1815)

> "She walks in Beauty, like the night / Of cloudless climes and starry skies"

It opens Byron's *Hebrew Melodies*, whose note in [volume 3 of The Works of Lord Byron](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/21811) is dated January 1815. It suits the girlfriend who wears black all year. Write it under a photo of her in costume.

### 2. Jane Austen, *Northanger Abbey* (1817)

> "The person, be it gentleman or lady, who has not pleasure in a good novel, must be intolerably stupid."

Henry Tilney says it in chapter 14, defending gothic novels. It suits the bookish girlfriend; tuck it into a secondhand gothic novel she has not read.

### 3. Emily Dickinson, "Ghosts" (1891)

> "One need not be a chamber to be haunted, / One need not be a house"

It appeared in *Poems: Second Series* in 1891, five years after her death in May 1886. It suits the thoughtful girlfriend, copied by hand into a notebook you give her.

### 4. Oscar Wilde, "The Canterville Ghost" (1887)

> "Love is always with you, and Love is stronger than Death is."

The ghost says it to Virginia; the story first appeared in 1887, per the [publication note in Wilde's collected stories](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/773). It suits the horror fan who cries at endings.

### 5. William Shakespeare, *Twelfth Night* (printed 1623)

> "Journeys end in lovers meeting"

Feste sings it in Act 2, Scene 3, and the play was first printed in the 1623 First Folio. At 30 characters, it suits a first Halloween together without promising forever.

### 6. William Shakespeare, Sonnet 116 (1609)

> "Love is not love / Which alters when it alteration finds"

The sonnets were first printed in 1609. This one suits a couple with several Octobers behind them; read it aloud rather than texting it.

One warning: a line credited to *Dracula* online, "I will not let you go into the unknown alone", does not appear in [Bram Stoker's full 1897 text](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/345). If a "classic" has no chapter you can find, leave it out.

## 18 original Halloween quotes for her, by personality

Every original line was checked for 5-word overlap against every other Halloween post and live article on this site; none shares a 5-word run. Pick her group, then change one word so it is yours.

### 7. For the girlfriend who lives for horror films (6 lines)

She knows the slasher rules better than the scriptwriters. Each line is under 15 words, short enough for a text.

- "You watch the scary part with your eyes open. I watch you."
- "Final girl energy, and somehow you picked me as your sidekick."
- "Every horror film says never split up. Good advice. Let's never."
- "You know every killer's backstory and still remember my coffee order."
- "I'd walk into the creepy basement for you. Slowly. Holding a torch."
- "Horror marathon queen of the sofa, and of my whole October."

### 8. For the girlfriend who scares easily (6 lines)

Some people love Halloween for the sweets and hate the jump scares. These 6 lines promise comfort instead.

- "No jump scares tonight, only warm socks and a happy ending."
- "You can hide behind me. I'm only pretending to be brave."
- "The only thing creeping up on you tonight is me with hot chocolate."
- "Lights on, blanket up, cartoon ghosts only. Your Halloween, your rules."
- "You hate scary things, which is why I'm the least scary thing here."
- "Cutest scaredy-cat I know, and I know a lot of cats."

### 9. For the bookish or witchy girlfriend (6 lines)

These pair well with the Austen and Dickinson lines. In a card, put the classic first.

- "Whatever spell you cast, it worked by chapter one."
- "Your bookmark has seen more ghosts than any haunted house."
- "Brewing tea, brewing plans, brewing trouble: you manage all three before noon."
- "Every gothic heroine needs someone to hold the candle. I volunteer."
- "You read tarot like footnotes and footnotes like spells."
- "My favourite witch keeps her potions in mugs and her secrets in margins."

## 18 original Halloween quotes by relationship stage

A 2026 brain-imaging study of [47 men with a female partner](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12873753) found the reward region's response to a girlfriend grew less distinct from a female friend's in longer relationships (3 to 81 months, median 13). The authors call that analysis exploratory, but the plain lesson holds: novelty fades and has to be put back on purpose.

### 10. Your first Halloween together (6 lines)

Keep these light, because she may fall for you on a different timetable. None of them says forever.

- "Our first 31 October. I'd like to book every one after it."
- "New to us, old to the calendar: our first Halloween."
- "Too early to say forever, so: same time next October?"
- "First Halloween with you, and I'm already planning the sequel."
- "You are the best plot twist of my year."
- "I showed up for the free sweets. I stayed for you."

### 11. Two or more Halloweens in (6 lines)

Long couples can be specific and a little soppy. Swap "years" for the real number of Halloweens you have shared.

- "Another October, same girl, more in love than the last time."
- "You've seen me in every terrible costume and stayed anyway."
- "Years of Halloweens and you still steal the good chocolate. I let you."
- "Our love has outlasted every pumpkin we've ever carved."
- "Same porch, same bowl of sweets, same favourite person."
- "Some things get spookier with age. We got sweeter."

### 12. When you are apart on 31 October (6 lines)

Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027, so a weekend video call is easy both years. Agree on a time before you send these.

- "Different cities, same moon on 31 October. Look up at nine."
- "My pumpkin wears your initial, so the porch feels less empty."
- "The miles are the only scary thing about this Halloween."
- "Save me a sweet. I'll collect in person, with interest."
- "Our time zones disagree, but tonight I'm on your clock."
- "One film, synced to the minute, on two sofas: that is a date."

## Which quote fits which moment? 4 places compared

This table compares four places to put a quote, with a SubhSandesh figure where one exists. Length is the main difference.

| Where it goes | Length that works | Best groups | SubhSandesh figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Text message | Under 15 words | Horror fan, scares easily, apart | 48.3% of shared pages opened on a phone |
| Handwritten card | 1 classic + 1 original | Bookish, years in | None (offline) |
| Photo caption | Under 10 words | Byron, first Halloween | None (posted publicly) |
| Halloween page | Question up to 60 characters | First Halloween, apart | 38.5% of creators add a password |

A text needs the shortest line. A page is the only option that puts the quote beside your photos and voice.

## Putting her quote on a Halloween page

The [interactive Halloween card with photos and music](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) takes about 5 minutes and holds up to six photos. She carves a pumpkin until your word glows, reads your letter by flashlight, then answers a question you can edit up to 60 characters, which "Journeys end in lovers meeting" fits easily.

Pick the [cinematic Halloween page with a voice note](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) if you want to read Sonnet 116 to her yourself. It takes about 10 minutes and adds a 60-second voice note, up to 12 photos, a 3,000-character letter, an optional unlock time and a reply box.

If she lives far away and Halloween is not her thing, the ["I miss you" page with open-when letters](https://subhsandesh.in/missyou-gf) suits the stage-12 lines better. Both Halloween pages take an optional password and republish to the same link. A shared SubhSandesh page averages 11.1 views, so expect her to reopen it.

## When a Halloween quote is the wrong choice

A quote is the wrong choice in at least 3 situations. If she is sitting next to you, say the line aloud instead of sending a link. If she dislikes Halloween, skip the theme and send something plain.

A line about her body, her fears or an inside joke belongs in a private message, not a public post. SubhSandesh pages are English-only and built for one person, not a group chat.

## Sources

- Bode, Luoto and Kavanagh, "Sex differences in romantic love", *Biology of Sex Differences*, 24 February 2025.
- Fujisaki, Ueda, Nakai and Abe, "Reduced neural specificity for a romantic partner in the nucleus accumbens over relationship duration", *Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience*, 2026.
- Cornell University Library, "Copyright Term and the Public Domain in the United States", updated 1 January 2026.
- Project Gutenberg ebooks 21811 (Byron), 773 (Wilde), 345 (Stoker).
- SubhSandesh platform data, measured 24 September 2026.
